cues.en: BLACK: Nobuhiko... is that you!?
BLACK: The one who tried to erase us Riders from history...!!
Shadow Moon: Long time no see, Black Sun.
Shadow Moon: So you stand in my way after all.
BLACK: ...If you threaten the peace of humanity,
BLACK: I'll defeat you as many times as it takes!!
Shadow Moon: Did you think power like that could stop my years of hatred!!
BLACK: ...Years of hatred? And this presence...
BLACK: You're... not Nobuhiko!
???: Hoh, so you noticed... Black Sun.
???: Indeed... Nobuhiko Akizuki, Shadow Moon,
???: no longer exists in this world.
???: My name is the Creation King!
BLACK: The Creation King...
BLACK: Impossible! I buried you back then...!!
Creation King: Indeed, Black Sun... but I have returned.
Creation King: That cursed day you ran my heart through...
Creation King: Do you remember what I said then?
Creation King: I will return. As long as evil lives in human hearts, I will surely return!
Creation King: True to those words, I dwelt in the evil of human hearts, reborn again and again.
Creation King: Gathering strength over a dizzying span of time, I waited for the day of my revival!
Creation King: And in a world far in the future, I finally found it.
Creation King: Yes, a device that can travel back through time...!
Creation King: With that device I returned to the past and moved my spirit into Shadow Moon's corpse.
Creation King: To take my revenge on you, and claim this world as mine once more!
Creation King: It was fun, Black Sun. Erasing your beloved comrades, the Kamen Riders, from this world!
BLACK: You...!!
Creation King: ...And yet my heart still found no relief.
Creation King: Hatred piled so high could never be cleared by that much!
Creation King: So when you came back, never learning your lesson...
Creation King: I realised that along with my rage, there was joy in my heart.
Creation King: Now I get to see your faces twisted in pain again!
Creation King: To watch you struggle like insects!
Creation King: It was a masterpiece! Watching you trade blows with your old friends!!
No. 1: ...Is that all you have to say?
Creation King: What...?
No. 1: No matter how many times you return, no matter how often you erase us from history,
No. 1: we'll return each time too, and stop your ambitions!
No. 1: As long as there is evil in this world... we Kamen Riders are immortal!!
Creation King: ...Interesting! Then satisfy me, Kamen Riders!!
